name: Nancy Drew Triple Threat
summary:
Play as Nancy Drew and solve the case / A challenging and exciting adventure / Roll the Dice in an Intricate Mini-Game Earn and Spend Euros on Trinkets and Souvenirs at the Castle Store Delve into German Culture Discover Captivating Facts and Local Lore.

A compilation that includes:
- Nancy Drew: Treasure in the Royal Tower
- Nancy Drew: The Final Scene
- Nancy Drew: Secret of the Scarlet Hand
